Automation by Linde Material Handling turns logistics into a composition.​ ​Like a mixing console, our holistic solution portfolio brings together proven AGVs, stationary automation and software – every channel adjustable, every signal synchronized.​ With Linde Material Handling as the producer and you as the creator, the result is a track precisely tuned, seamlessly integrated, and always in sync with your rhythm.​

Just as the beat provides the foundation of a song, services and process competence form the solid backbone of automation. At Linde Material Handling, we act like skilled sound engineers: combining deep process knowledge with comprehensive services, we adjust the mixing console's faders to create a perfect composure – precisely tailored to your individual challenges. From the first analysis to ongoing operations, our solution designers and automation experts always strike the right note – backed by proven expertise, the densest service network, and global reach. Always attuned to your needs to boost your performance.
Linde Material Handling supports customers from first ideas to long-term optimization of their processes.
End-to-end consulting: from analysis, simulation and planning to implementation and operation
Tailored fleet concepts: leaner, more energy-efficient, safer and more productive
​Adaptive process design: from reconfigured layouts to fully automated sites
Comprehensive service: 7,400 technicians at 700 locations, available 24/7
​This holistic approach ensures efficiency, reliability and financial viability – all from a single source.​

Mobile and stationary automation form the instruments in the mix of modern intralogistics. Proven AGVs as well as storage and transportation solutions are designed to interact seamlessly – versatile, flexible and tuned to a perfect integrated solution. This creates a harmonious material flow that makes your automation solution the steady beat of long-term efficiency.
Based on our proven technology, our mix of mobile and stationary automation solutions is robust, reliable and performance-driven.​
​One of the broadest portfolios on the market
Modular, scalable and customizable
Industrial-scale production with the flexibility of bespoke engineering
Deeply embedded safety expertise with redundant systems and intelligent sensors
Seamless integration of manual and automated fleets as well as storage systems
​The result: sustainable performance and true one-stop solutions.
Facilitates horizontal goods movement, transporting pallets and rolling racks in warehouses and production environments.
Optimized for material handling in tight spaces, ground transport, conveyor belt use, and low-level storage and retrieval.
Enables high-density storage and retrieval of Euro and industrial pallets in warehouses with limited space.
Efficiently handles Euro and industrial pallets, storing and retrieving loads in wide-aisle warehouses.

Like a mixing console that unites all channels, our software solutions ensure seamless integration: processes, mobile and stationary automation or manual fleets interact and ensure that all systems play together in perfect sync. Scalable, secure and adaptable at any time – for full control and maximum transparency in real time.​
Our software connects all layers to guarantee seamless integration and reliable intralogistics.​
​Quick start: Fast implementation of our AGV solution portfolio with our control software MATIC:move​
Grow: Add more complexity and scale with MATIC:move+ as your business evolves​
Flexible connection: Use your individual warehouse systems (WMS, SAP) or our performant inhouse WMS Linde Warehouse Manager​ to ensure your material flow
Open interfaces and VDA-5050 compliance for interoperability and future-proof investment​
Certified data protection and cybersecurity for maximum trust and transparency​
​This creates a holistic system that grows with your business, delivering measurable efficiency and long-term success.

Linde Material Handling crafts powerful automation solutions precisely composed around you. Enjoy seamless integration and unparalleled efficiency, ensuring your entire operation is always perfectly in sync with your rhythm.
